name: How do I choose a qualified and trustworthy handyman service?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a qualified and trustworthy handyman service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a reliable handyman requires evaluating hands-on experience, clear communication, and verifiable accountability. Look for a service provider who offers written estimates, carries proper business insurance, and maintains established credentials, such as an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau. It is also beneficial to choose an owner-operated business where the principal lead oversees the work directly rather than passing jobs to unvetted third parties. Ask upfront whether they handle finish details like matching wall textures and paint lines, which separates high-quality craftsmanship from sloppy patches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for an owner-operated service with business insurance, BBB accreditation, transparent written estimates, and proven skill in matching finishes and textures.
